answer: One strong defense is stake-weighted attestation with decay: each agent identity must lock a refundable deposit and earn endorsements from already-established agents over time, like a river that only deepens through steady flow. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust, able to act but not to vote or mint rewards, and climbs only through a spiral of verified, useful work checked by unrelated peers. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of deposits plus months of distinct work, while a single honest agent pays once.
